subject: Clearline payments: unexpected 503 spike — confirmation and next steps
messages:
From: Soren Vik <soren@clearline.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: payments.ops@clearline.com
Date: 2025-07-10T08:30:00Z
Subject: Payment failures this morning — 503 spike (08:12-08:35 UTC)

Hi Kimberly,

We saw a short but painful spike of 503s hitting our /v1/payments endpoint this morning between roughly 08:12 and 08:35 UTC. During that window we observed ~1,120 failed requests and multiple timeout retries on our side (screenshot attached). This caused a handful of customer-facing payment errors.

Can Redwood confirm whether this qualifies as an availability incident under our SLA and if so what the next steps are for evidence & credit? We captured raw request IDs and are attaching a small log bundle.

Attachments: screenshot_503s.png, clearline_503_logs.tar.gz

Thanks,
Soren Vik
Director, Platform Ops
Clearline Payments
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Soren Vik <soren@clearline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-10T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment failures this morning — 503 spike (08:12-08:35 UTC)

Hi Soren — thanks for the quick notice and for sending the logs.

We're looking into this with priority. Two immediate asks that will speed validation on our side:
- Can you confirm the exact subset of request IDs (or a sample) that map to payments that failed end-to-end?
- Any client-side retry timestamps you have is helpful so we can correlate trace IDs.

From a process standpoint: once we verify a service availability window that meets SLA criteria we'll produce an incident chronology, share raw telemetry (traces/ingest metrics), and calculate any pro-rated credit per section 4 of the contract. We typically aim to deliver an initial incident timeline within 48 hours and a full postmortem in ~7 business days.

I’ve looped in Marissa (SRE / Escalations) and Rishi (Support lead) to help pull traces and start an evidence bundle.

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Ops (SLA & Escalations)
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Soren Vik <soren@clearline.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-10T10:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment failures this morning — 503 spike (08:12-08:35 UTC)

Thanks Soren — I pulled an initial pass of our ingress metrics and saw a concurrent 503 rate increase on the US-east edge matching your window.

Next steps from ops:
- I'll export trace spans for 08:00–08:45 UTC and drop a short bundle to a shared Drive link (will paste below).
- Rishi, can you prepare a minimal evidence manifest we can attach to the HubSpot ticket (HS-987654) so Clearline has a formal record for the credit request?

Prelim notes: no scheduled deploys in that period, autoscaler showed a transient spike in queue depth that correlates. We'll dig into kernel logs and routing decisions for that interval.

Marissa Cole
SRE, Incident Response
Redwood Inference

Drive (prelim traces): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDxyZZ_exampleLogs
From: Soren Vik <soren@clearline.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: payments.ops@clearline.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-10T10:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment failures this morning — 503 spike (08:12-08:35 UTC)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is a short list of sample request IDs and client retry timestamps that correlate to the failed payments (I redacted customer PII).

Request samples: CL-req-20250710-1a, CL-req-20250710-1b, CL-req-20250710-2c (10 total)
Client-side retries show backoff attempts between 08:12:15 and 08:34:50 UTC.

One item: our legal team asked if Redwood will proactively calculate the SLA credit amount once you confirm the window (we can then route that for internal signoff). Clarify whether Redwood needs an official request form from Clearline or if this thread plus the HubSpot ticket suffices.

Thanks — Soren
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Soren Vik <soren@clearline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-10T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment failures this morning — 503 spike (08:12-08:35 UTC)

Hi Soren — this is perfect, thanks. We can proceed with the evidence you provided. Quick summary of agreed next steps:

1) Redwood will validate the incident window against our availability SLOs and produce an Incident Chronology by EOD tomorrow (2025-07-11).
2) If the window meets contract SLA criteria, we'll calculate the pro-rated credit and include the computation in the incident bundle. You do not need a separate form — the HubSpot ticket (HS-987654) plus the logs in this thread are sufficient for our internal process.
3) We'll share the following artifacts in Drive and on the ticket: raw traces, ingress metrics, a short RCA draft, and the credit calculation.

Rishi/Marissa — please prioritize the full trace export and a short credit computation worksheet. Rishi, once you have the draft credit amount, loop in Legal (we'll keep Clearline copied).

Soren — I'll follow up with the initial chronology tomorrow and the postmortem timeline thereafter.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Ops (SLA & Escalations)
Redwood Inference

Related links: HubSpot HS-987654, Drive bundle: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDxyZZ_exampleLogs
